title: SMS outreach: off-channel chat switch
banner: Synthetic mobile text scenario; public listing data; no employer affiliation.
whatItShows: An unsolicited text cites a real internship and steers the conversation to WhatsApp before asking for a refundable deposit and login code.
text:
[SMS / Text Message]
Hi Jordan, this is Taylor from the campus recruiting desk regarding Figma's Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027) opening (requisition 6143238004). We saw your resume and want to fast-track your interview today.

Do not apply on the public careers page—can we continue on WhatsApp with our hiring coordinator at @figma_talent_desk.invalid so we can lock in your slot?
followUpText: Before we release your interview link on WhatsApp, send the $150 refundable workstation deposit via Zelle to our equipment coordinator and reply with the verification code just sent to your phone.
